data.title: Re-capture Running Log + Fractal NYC media at 1000px pipeline quality (live URLs)

data.body: Re-captured from live URLs, all files verified visually (frames read). prototype-03.gif (Running Log): 680x425 4.78MB -> 720x450 5.9MB; scroll-through of card grid w/ animated GIF thumbnails (4 autoplaying GIFs forced width/fps down to keep <6MB). fractal-nyc.gif (hero): 820x461 2.3MB -> 770x481 5.8MB; gentle-orbit Three.js octahedron in motion, faces morph/texture, seamless loop. Six house stills fractal-nyc-{home,visit,events,campus,education,publications}.png all 1600x1138 (unchanged dims), captured at 2880x2048 retina and lanczos-downscaled; each themed house crisp & distinct. Note: uniform 1000px goal not achievable for the two animated-heavy GIFs under the hard <6MB cap (WebGL + autoplaying GIF thumbnails = every-frame-unique); widths held as high as the cap allowed. No edits to works.json/page.tsx/content.ts; no publish; no commit.
